name: CNOOC Engineering (COOEC)
description: Offshore oil engineering arm of CNOOC Group (Shanghai 600583, HQ Tianjin Binhai): design and construction of offshore platforms and offshore EPC, expanding into clean energy such as CCUS. Sister services company CNOOC Energy Technology & Services (600968) provides the group's one-stop production services.
